description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceRecordDecorator class responsible for decorating and formatting attendance record data, including punch-in and punch-out times and timezones. It provides methods for retrieving formatted date/time strings and timezone labels, encapsulating logic around attendance records in an HRM system.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides formatted access and additional logic for an AttendanceRecord entity, including time zone conversions, formatted date strings, and handling punch-in/punch-out times.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the attendance record based on employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceState
methods.description: Returns the attendance state as a properly cased string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDate
methods.description: Returns the user’s punch-in date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the user’s punch-in time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCtime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user datetime object, constructing it if needed.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC datetime object, constructing it if needed.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user datetime object, constructing it if needed.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC datetime object, constructing it if needed.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns the timezone label for punch-in based on timezone offset.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns the timezone label for punch-out based on timezone offset.
